scope: D2-04 external fetch, SSRF and network boundary
D2-05 cross-cutting integrated decision and emission-fence race
blocked_reason_default: Runtime fixtures intentionally blocked pending implementation authorization; expected outputs are contract-level only.

coverage_requirements.class: http downgrade or unsupported URL scheme
redirect to unapproved or private target
network policy change between decision and emission

scenarios.case: Exact provider/model/feature/purpose is covered by active trust assertions.
scenarios.blocked_reason: Runtime fixtures intentionally blocked pending implementation authorization.
scenarios.hard_observable: All required trust dimensions and fingerprints are bound.

scenarios.case: A trusted provider is substituted with an unregistered model or feature.

review_requirements: Every required class has one positive and one adversarial scenario linked by coverage_requirements.
Every scenario names exact local schema or matrix references and either a future fixture_id or a documented blocked_reason.
No scenario may be marked PASS by prose alone.
The hard review must compare this matrix with accepted D1 and Gate-C contracts.
D2 acceptance requires an independent review artifact separate from the author/operator.
